summary: When one resident signed up for a municipal outdoor initiative earlier this summer, taking a walk in the rain was not part of the plan. title: Prosecutors seek 10-year sentence for Pakistani man in child rape case
summary: Prosecutors have sought a heavy sentence for a Pakistani national indicted for sexually assaulting foreign children nearly two decades earlier at an Islamic mosque in Incheon, west of Seoul, judicial officials said Monday. Prosecutors asked the Bucheon branch of the Incheon District Court to sentence the unidentified Pakistani man to 10 years in prison on charges including rape of minors under the age of 13, during a hearing in mid-July, the officials said. The man is accused of threatening and sexually assaulting two foreign children, then aged 7 and 9, at a mosque in Incheon's Seohae district in September 2008. He was teaching the Quran at the mosque at the time. Prosecutors said a complaint was filed belatedly because the victims were too young at the time of the incident.

title: Korea steps up checks on Chinese cabbage, kimchi amid formaldehyde scare
summary: Korean authorities have intensified safety checks on imported Chinese cabbage and kimchi — staples of Korean cuisine — after a Chinese supplier was found to have used formaldehyde, a known human carcinogen, to extend the shelf life of harvested cabbages. Central and local authorities say they have strengthened inspections at ports of entry while expanding testing for the chemical and other potentially harmful substances in food ingredients from China. title: Seoul finds harmful substances in 7 children's products
summary: Products marketed for children 14 and older are drawing scrutiny after Seoul officials had safety concerns or found harmful substances in seven of 20 products tested. The Seoul Metropolitan Government said Tuesday that its testing found excessive levels of phthalate plasticizers, cadmium and other substances in sensory toys, stickers and keycap key rings sold through overseas online platforms and domestic stationery stores. The products were labeled for users 14 and older, meaning they were not subject to mandatory certification, but officials compared their safety results with standards applied to products intended for children ages 8 and older. summary: The main opposition People Power Party (PPP) on Monday criticized President Lee Jae Myung's latest Cabinet reshuffle, accusing him of putting his political interests before improving people's livelihoods. title: Immigration detainees lack access to key forms, rights information: watchdog
summary: The state human rights watchdog has called for stronger procedural safeguards for foreign nationals in immigration detention after inspections found inadequate access to review and temporary release forms, as well as insufficient guidance on detainees’ rights. The National Human Rights Commission of Korea (NHRCK) said Monday it inspected the Seoul Immigration Office, the Hwaseong Immigration Detention Center and the Cheongju Immigration Detention Center to see how the revised Immigration Act has operated in the field since taking effect in June 2025. title: Seoul district steps up housing protections for foreign tenants
summary: Navigating the intricacies of Korea’s residential real estate market is notoriously complex even for long-term local residents. title: Land minister nominee vows close consultations with Seoul on housing supply
summary: The nominee to head the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport said Monday he will closely consult with the Seoul city government to narrow differences over housing supply plans. Hong Jee-sun, currently vice land minister, made the remarks a day after he was tapped to replace Land Minister Kim Yun-duk, who had faced opposition from the Seoul city government over a proposal to use parts of Yongsan Park in central Seoul for housing development. title: Gov't launches 2nd half program to recover remains of fallen Korean War soldiers
summary: The defense ministry said Monday it has launched second-half operations to recover and identify the remains of soldiers killed in the 1950-53 Korean War, continuing its efforts to bring closure to families of service members killed in action or still missing. The Agency for KIA Recovery and Identification under the ministry will carry out the excavation project starting Monday through Nov. 27, deploying troops from 14 Army divisions and brigades, and the 1st Marine Division, the ministry said. title: Unification Church leader sentenced to 2-year prison term in bribery case
summary: A Seoul district court on Monday sentenced Unification Church leader Han Hak-ja to two years in prison in a bribery case where the religious group sought to secure favors from the administration of former President Yoon Suk Yeol.
